description: This file defines the SpotsController class, which manages data retrieval and caching for various CRM-related entities such as accounts, leads, sales, services, activities, marketing campaigns, marketing activities, and quotes. It includes methods for generating and serving cached JSON data files by executing database queries tailored for MySQL or MSSQL, with access control integrated. The class extends a SugarController and provides specific methods for each data type, utilizing external beans and configuration.

classes.name: SpotsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing cached data files related to CRM entities such as accounts, leads, sales, services, activities, marketing, and quotes. Implements methods to retrieve, generate, and serve JSON files, with configurations for database type and access control.

methods.name: getDatabaseType
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the database type in use ('mysql', 'mssql', or 'undefined').

methods.name: buildSpotsAccessQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns a SQL WHERE clause for access control based on user permissions.

methods.name: action_getAccountsSpotsData
methods.description: Serves the cached accounts data JSON. Creates the cache if stale or missing.

methods.name: action_createAccountsSpotsData
methods.description: Generates the accounts data cache file by querying the database and applying access control.

methods.name: action_getLeadsSpotsData
methods.description: Serves the cached leads data JSON. Creates the cache if needed.

methods.name: action_createLeadsSpotsData
methods.description: Generates the leads data cache JSON from database queries with access control.

methods.name: action_getSalesSpotsData
methods.description: Serves the cached sales data JSON, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: action_createSalesSpotsData
methods.description: Creates the sales data cache JSON from database queries with access control.

methods.name: action_getServiceSpotsData
methods.description: Serves the cached service data JSON, generating it if stale or absent.

methods.name: action_createServiceSpotsData
methods.description: Generates the service data cache JSON from database queries, with access control.

methods.name: action_getActivitiesSpotsData
methods.description: Serves the cached activities data JSON, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: action_createActivitiesSpotsData
methods.description: Creates the activities data cache JSON by querying calls, meetings, and tasks with access control.

methods.name: action_getMarketingSpotsData
methods.description: Serves the cached marketing campaign data JSON, generating if needed.

methods.name: action_createMarketingSpotsData
methods.description: Generates marketing campaign data cache JSON including campaign, opportunity, and account info, with access control.

methods.name: action_getMarketingActivitySpotsData
methods.description: Serves the cached marketing activity data JSON, creating if missing.

methods.name: action_createMarketingActivitySpotsData
methods.description: Creates cache JSON for marketing campaign activities, with access restrictions.

methods.name: action_getQuotesSpotsData
methods.description: Serves quotes data JSON, creates cache if absent or stale.

methods.name: action_createQuotesSpotsData
methods.description: Generates quotes data cache JSON from multiple joined tables with access control.
